label: Pyreon + @pyreon/router + @pyreon/store
state: @pyreon/store defineStore: signals for products, filters, page and favourites; computeds for the filtered list, page rows, page count and summary
notes: Two sources for @pyreon/*, chosen by `bun setup.ts --pyreon=npm|workspace` and recorded in run.json: npm (default) installs the published packages this arm's package-lock.json pins; workspace installs nothing here and resolves the monorepo's built lib/.
The router's defaults are kept: no View Transitions (they are opt-in) and 'intent' link prefetch (a no-op here: no route has a loader).
Rows render with <For by={id}>; a row reads the favourites Set signal, so a favourite toggle re-runs the 50 visible rows' favourite bindings (no createSelector: the docs' plain shape).
